passages.title: Scope of the authored requirements analysis
passages.text: The authored case analysis yields a handover structure with a located source, a bounded next action and a visible decision boundary. R2 supplies a receiver's stated obstacles, while R1, R3–R5 supply explicit requirements. These records support the requirements below within the fictional scenario. They provide no evidence that this structure improves real project outcomes.

passages.title: Current material prohibition, R5
passages.text: Original project material is prohibited throughout the workshop, including anonymized, redacted, paraphrased or otherwise transformed excerpts. Use only wholly fictional training material authored for the workshop.

passages.title: Pending format choice, H-01
passages.text: H-01 is a choice between the two stated teaching formats. Both use only fictional material. The open choice affects case-sheet allocation and the task during the comparison slot. The current material restriction has already been supplied by R5 and awaits no choice in this scenario.

introductions.heading: Workshop plan
introductions.problem: A workshop needs a complete sequence, source-bound activities and an explicit material rule.
introductions.result: The authored 90-minute plan, worksheet and completed model handover use only fictional training material. H-01 remains open; printing, delivery and acceptance are unperformed.
introductions.use: Follow the nine agenda intervals, then inspect the complete worksheet, model handover and R5 change record. H-01 controls the format and final sheet allocation.

table.caption: Agenda for the 90-minute workshop
rows: Read the question and material rule. Participants identify the source IDs on the sheet.
Inspect the weak handover and identify missing information against R2. Each pair marks two gaps.
Trace one row of the requirements matrix into the model handover. Each pair distinguishes source wording, interpretation and open decision.
Read the assigned fictional case and complete W1–W2.
Complete W3–W5 and the draft handover.
Exchange sheets. The receiver performs the source-based peer review and returns the complete form to its author.
Revise one finding. In a mixed room, compare the decision boundaries of U and C. In an audience-specific room, inspect a second row in the same case.
Each pair reads the next permitted action and stopping condition aloud. Complete the exit check and retain the revision record.

passages.title: Current exercise and R5 material rule
passages.text: Use only Case U or Case C, revision `training-v2`, supplied in [the training source](#training-source). Complete the [worksheet](#workshop-worksheet) with the case ID and row references. Prepare the receiver to summarize the rows that already have categories. Preserve the ambiguous row for the designated fictional decision owner. Exchange the handover and inspect it against the same source. Record one finding, revise the handover and retain the changed wording. Original project material, including anonymized, redacted or paraphrased excerpts, is prohibited throughout the exercise and discussion. This instruction implements RQ-01–RQ-08, especially [R5](#r5-replacement-material-rule).

passages.title: H-01 formats and allocation consequence
passages.text: The handover fields and review criteria remain the same. In a mixed-room format, pairs compare the two contexts during minutes 72–82. In an audience-specific format, pairs inspect a second row in their selected case during that slot. [H-01](#r6-pending-human-choice) leaves the format and final sheet allocation with the fictional sponsor.

passages.title: Authored planning result and no-delivery limit
passages.text: The workshop builds on the requirements synthesis. Its authored planning result is complete. No workshop was scheduled or delivered. The supporting archive retains the source and supersession record as completed authored background, without a follow-up assignment. H-01 remains with the fictional workshop sponsor; both room formats are prepared and final printing and case allocation wait for that choice.
